description.value: Frisby Ridge Sushi is a traditional Japanese cuisine and sushi restaurant in Revelstoke, BC, operating since 1999. Situated in a mountain town well-known to cyclists and outdoor enthusiasts, it offers dine-in seating in a comfortable setting. The restaurant takes reservations and has been a local fixture for over two decades.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms the business name, phone number, and address (201 1 St West, Revelstoke, BC), matching OSM data. The site describes a traditional Japanese dine-in sushi restaurant established in 1999 with a reservation system, but makes no mention of bike parking, washrooms, takeout, Wi-Fi, or any other cyclist-relevant amenities. A notable discrepancy exists between OSM opening hours (Mon–Sat open, Sun evening open) and the website (Tue–Sat only, Sun–Mon closed); the website is preferred per rules.
concerns: Opening hours discrepancy: OSM tags show Mo-Sa 11:30-21:00 and Su 16:00-21:00 (Monday open, Sunday evening open), but the website consistently states Tue–Sat 12:00pm–9:00pm with Sun–Mon closed. Website is preferred; OSM hours appear outdated.
OSM address lacks city/province; website confirms Revelstoke, BC V0E.
